reason: Cline preparation blocked: Issue #2153 is a meta/umbrella tracker, not a request for a concrete code change to this repository, and its only attached funding is a stale Bountysource bounty that the participants themselves describe as no longer applicable. (1) Title is literally '[tracker] AArch64 progress' and the body is an open-ended checklist/milestone list ('Open items: C varargs ... std.numeric.CustomFloat ... remaining quadruple-precision constants ... -NaN asserts') plus 'Upstream PRs to integrate into ltsmaster' spanning ldc, druntime (dlang/druntime#2257, #1267), phobos (dlang/phobos#3598/#5442/#5443/#5444/#5445/#5458/#5459/#5947) and dmd (dlang/dmd#6857/#6858) - a multi-year, multi-repository effort with no single reproducible defect, no target symbol/file in this repo, and no acceptance test. (2) The funding recorded in admission ($2000, payer 'dnadlinger', source https://github.com/ldc-developers/ldc/issues/2153#issuecomment-579253239) is a Bountysource bounty (issue comment 581655910 links https://www.bountysource.com/issues/45907409-tracker-aarch64-progress) that the parties consider dead: issue comment 1174267378 (kinke, 2022-07-04) 'the bounty less so in the sense of the few remaining parts IMO definitely not justifying the full bounty', and comment 1177252534 (dnadlinger, 2022-07-07) 'I thought they were bought out by some ... weird entity at some point ... if no, maybe we should just call it quits; if yes, maybe those of us having done major amounts of work so far can push through to full support and then split the bounty up', referencing closed https://github.com/bountysource/core/issues/1539 ('What is wrong with your support and cash out process?'). (3) The remainder is AArch64-native work: reproducing requires native aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu hardware/CI (varargs core.stdc.stdarg.AAPCS64, C++ ABI, quad-precision real tests, '-NaN' assert in std.math/std.algorithm.sorting), which is unavailable on this x86_64 runner; the reported symptoms are library/ABI behaviors that, per the issue, occur 'only when natively compiling on AArch64'. (4) Live verification on 2026-10-31: issue still open, label B-aarch64, 66 comments, unchanged since 2022-07-29; no open PR referencing issue 2153 (GitHub search total_count=0). Per instructions, do not convert this tracker/withdrawn-funding issue into a fallback proposal or PR: action=blocked and the checkout is left unchanged (no worktree created, no edits, no fork).
